content.summary: Sepia duelists exchange cobalt contact arcs across a ruined paper platform. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.recommended_input: Draw one adult reed-cloaked duelist and one broad stone guardian in sepia pencil crosshatching on cream paper. Use two grounded exchanges, each producing one bounded cobalt arc at actual contact. Pull wide as both figures settle at opposite edges, fragments fall and the cobalt route line remains between them.
